label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (xss) is TP. The variable corr is assigned from request.getHeader('X-Correlation-Id') (L17), representing attacker-controllable HTTP header input. This value is concatenated directly into response.getWriter().println(...) (L22) without any HTML encoding or sanitization. Since the response Content-Type is text/html (L10), the raw header value is rendered in the HTML body, creating a reflected XSS vulnerability.

evidence.note: User input retrieved from X-Correlation-Id header
Unsanitized header value echoed to HTML response writer
